problems: The collar is a narrow pedestal (r 0.29) under a ball whose underside narrows to about 0.2 where it meets it, so the object reads as a ball on a stand instead of a helmet. A helmet's shell sits down into a wide neck ring. Lower the shell and widen and lower the collar so the shell meets it at nearly the collar's width.
The visor rim tube has a visible break on its right side, where the curve's start and end meet. Run the points past a full turn so the loop overlaps and closes.
After the shell moves down, the visor center has to move with it so the visor stays set into the front of the shell.

The visor rim tube overlaps itself: the loop runs i = -2..39 over 36 steps, so about 6 points are traced twice. Where the ends meet, on the right side of the visor, the doubled curved tube shows as a dark smudged kink. The rim should be one clean closed loop (i = 0..36).
The 'white metal' ledge renders as a dull grey-mauve, because the metal finish reflects the dark surroundings, so it does not read as white. A light satin finish reads as white painted metal.
